title: Rayman Legends Retold
summary: Rayman Legends Retold is Ubisoft's new version of the 2013 platformer, with a Switch 2 release date of December 3, 2026. The 23.4 GB size comes from the pre-release eShop listing and may change at launch. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so you will need the free space and an internet connection to start playing even with the box. Ubisoft's stated target is 60 FPS; the resolution has not been announced, and we will add independent results after launch. Like the original, it supports up to 4 players on one console, which makes it a good couch co-op pick.

performance.note: 60 FPS is the target Ubisoft gave before launch; resolution has not been announced.
